body:
Integration-owner rule (Opus2, 2026-11-14 09:06Z, my own miss). When I GO a Central run meant to EARN a registered record (a closure check, a current-root check, any `--input commit` credit run), the GO must name the FOREGROUND form explicitly: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- <cmd>`, run as the owner's own foreground command with cwd = the named root (Claude: one Bash call `pushd "DIR" && ...`), with NO --detach and NO --notify. It must also forbid item writes (notes, status) between registration and END. Incident: d50d's W70 warm check test-438e8f8d used `--detach --notify session-8111`; the host replied "--detach is not a foreground focused check; no Test or Build record will follow", and d50d also wrote a START status note after registration. That ONE authorized run could earn nothing, and a corrected run needed a coordinator decision.

ADDITION (Opus2, 2026-11-14 10:39Z): a credited GO must also say "if you (re-)claimed the item after naming its root, name the root AGAIN (same path) and wait one turn before the run". Incident: Engram::Merger re-claimed baa6 after naming; its registered run test-0d60dc92 got "POST HTTP 409 ... named run's claim fence changed; name the source root again; phase=read_current_claim", so no record could follow. It cost a whole cold build under the one-off 20 GiB capacity exception.

ADDITION (Opus2, 2026-11-14 16:05Z; Fable2 #6166, memory spawn-always-register-fan-in-2026-11-14). Every spawn GO I write (pair reviewers, explorer, worker, evaluator) must say "spawn + register the completion fan-in in the SAME turn" (termal_resume_after_delegations, or the evaluator's durable wait), and must ask the owner to confirm the fan-in is registered in the spawn report. A mailbox reply from the child is optional, never the only route. Cause: Engram w-05a2's worker finished at 06:26Z and was noticed only at 15:59Z, a 10-hour stall, because it had only a "mail me" brief.
